calibration_evidence.coding_batch_equation: exp(beta*rho)*(sum(kappa_i*t_i)+max((1-kappa_i)*t_i)); interpolate four packing knots; ANY context>16384 serializes entire batch; empty=0

coding_packing.split: Within each condition, first two uniform episodes fit; third uniform and all mixed episodes validate

historical_transfer_checks.scope: Long-pack serial family chosen after inspecting these 72 episodes: external calibration check, not untouched holdout; same recorded vLLM0.22/LMCache0.5.1 image path, not a verified identical image hash; older vLLM0.10 c2/c4 runs excluded

calibration_evidence.power_scope: Direct coding pre-window median and separate awake-idle anchor; partial/fleet/workload transfer assumed; fitted partial-power curve unused; idle held fixed
calibration_evidence.timing_scope: Fixed width-eight 2048-14336-token pack; 2048/32 prefill-heavy resident requests; offered-rate normalization, not GPU utilization; wall endpoint time, not intrinsic GPU work
calibration_evidence.timing_transfer: Coding uses independently calibrated width-eight packing; intermediate widths, context interpolation, the 16384-token switching boundary and loaded coding resident mixtures remain transfers; beta comes from the fixed loaded pack; do not also divide service by 1-rho
calibration_evidence.transition_limit: Three discrete eager-A100/4K recipes at combined W=.50; no generic SLO cap or transfer to new mixtures
calibration_evidence.transition_scope: live materialization of eight sessions followed by 240 seconds of offered work at the plan's three exact normalized phase-work recipes

interval_scope: scenario-reoptimized workload/calibration sensitivity; not transfer-error or fixed-plan coverage
power_scope: linear measured-anchor proxy; workload transfer; no shutdown
